Value: This is a documented-coverage dataset, not a complete census of Indian salt pans. Industry summaries citing Salt Commissioner data report ~11,453 manufacturers on ~7.47 lakh acres (UJA, 2025) and ~6.16 lakh acres in 2014-15 (Tamil Nadu Salt Corporation); only named/identifiable sites and regional clusters found in accessible sources are included here.
No polygon boundaries were included: the NRSC/ISRO Salt Pan Atlas of India (30+ MB PDF), SCO land records and Bhuvan layers could not be programmatically retrieved; none were fabricated.
Coordinates for regional/cluster rows are Wikipedia infobox centroids of the nearest town/lake/subdivision and are flagged Region-level or Approximate; do not use them as pan locations.

Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep: no reliable site-level documentation was found, so no records were added. Raigad/Ratnagiri (Maharashtra), Porbandar, Ramanathapuram and Cuddalore were mentioned only in low-reliability sources and were not added.
Sources that could not be fetched directly (site blocks automated access): saltcomindia.gov.in PDF was read from search snippets only. NRSC atlas PDF exceeded the fetch size limit.
All URLs were returned by search/fetch results during compilation. HTTP validity could not be re-tested from the offline sandbox; re-validate before publishing.
The brief listed 'Satellite_Source' twice (#36 and #105). #105 was renamed 'Satellite_Source_Citation' to keep column names unique for GIS import.

Conflicting figures were left unresolved and flagged (Area_Check = Review): AP land (19,026 vs 20,716 acres), Goa (2,978 ha; Pernem 18.0232 ha = 4.5%), Sanikatta (400 vs 500 acres), Thoothukudi (25,000 acres, journalist figure), Tamil Nadu production share (11% vs ~6%).
